searchLog: 12th+ straight day of the same network-egress failure (logged 2026-09-22 through 2026-10-01, now 2026-10-02 too). Independently re-verified today from this cloud session's own proxy (curl to http://127.0.0.1:39443/__agentproxy/status confirms the proxy is up and healthy -- this is an org-level allowlist denial, not a tool/cert bug): job-boards.greenhouse.io, boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.ashbyhq.com, stripe.com, www.databricks.com, www.metacareers.com, www.google.com, www.ycombinator.com, and even en.wikipedia.org all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED. Only www.anthropic.com and github.com loaded. This is not a job-board-vendor-specific block -- it is a near-total WebFetch allowlist of effectively two domains, so no candidate company page, program page, or fellowship page could be opened and verified today, including ones not on Greenhouse/Ashby. WebSearch itself works (confirmed via one query) and surfaced plausible-sounding Anthropic Applied AI Architect reqs via third-party aggregators (jobs.accel.com, seedtable.com), but per the hunt rules a search snippet or aggregator listing is never sufficient to confirm a role is open and the user is eligible -- that requires fetching the real application page, which is blocked. Zero verified opportunities is the correct and honest output. This is not fixable by changing search strategy, trying mirrors, or retrying -- it requires a human to widen the network egress allowlist for this scheduled routine's environment. This has now silently degraded the daily email to its Google-News-RSS fallback for 12+ consecutive days.
